verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a public REST/HTTP API for driving Sentry. Probes for an OpenAPI spec at every candidate path returned 404. The documented CLI and llms.txt are adjacent capabilities belonging to other stories, and SDK instrumentation docs cover sending data in, not driving the product, so none of these count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
